description:
Create a warehouse floor plan for the 'NorthEast Distribution Center'. 

Starting from a blank diagram or Floor Plan template in EdrawMax:
1. Create a large rectangular building shell.
2. Add 3 Loading Docks on the TOP wall, labeled 'Dock 1', 'Dock 2', and 'Dock 3'.
3. Create a storage area in the center with 4 parallel rows of Pallet Racks, labeled 'Row A', 'Row B', 'Row C', and 'Row D'.
4. Create a packing area in the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner with a Conveyor Belt or packing tables, labeled 'Packing Station'.
5. Add at least 2 Forklift vehicles in the aisles.
6. Add text labels for the three main operational zones: 'Zone 1: Receiving' (top near docks), 'Zone 2: Bulk Storage' (center racks), and 'Zone 3: Outbound' (bottom right).
7. Add the title 'NorthEast Distribution Center' at the top of the diagram.

Save the native file to '/home/ga/Diagrams/warehouse_layout.eddx' and export an image to '/home/ga/Diagrams/warehouse_layout.png'.
